service.en: Reconcile on a health insurance violation
service.ur: ہیلتھ انشورنس خلاف ورزی پر مصالحت

about: Settle a Department of Health violation decision under the health insurance law by paying 75% of its value.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Power of attorney and signature approval
Signed violation decision approving the reconciliation
fees: No extra costs beyond paying 75% of the current violation value
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
